summary: Removes Python from the hot-path no-cargo advisory runtime hook while preserving Cargo warning, quoted-search suppression, and direct rustfmt allowance behavior.

facets.F1_scope: P00 read-only hook enhancement cleanup slice; only no-cargo runtime extraction and its regression tests changed.
F3_tests: bash scripts/tests/governance-hooks-retired-vcs-surfaces.test.sh; governance hook retired VCS/wrapper surface tests passed
manual hook payload smoke: cargo test warns; escaped quoted cargo search is silent; rustfmt command is silent
facets.F4_security: Reduces runtime interpreter dependency in advisory PreToolUse hook; no new permissions, network, or mutation path.
facets.F5_privacy: Hook reads only stdin payload and emits advisory stderr; no persisted data.
facets.F6_reliability: Existing and new regression tests cover non-blocking behavior, cargo fmt guidance, quoted/escaped search false-positive suppression, and rustfmt allowance.
facets.F7_operability: Runtime command path remains unchanged for Codex/Gemini configs; only extraction implementation changed.
facets.F8_performance: Avoids spawning Python on every Bash pre-tool hook invocation.
facets.F9_maintainability: Keeps hook logic small and covered while the Rust/Buck2 manifest checker owns drift evidence.
facets.F10_compatibility: Preserves existing hook stdout/stderr contract and exit 0 behavior.
